objective: evaluate the frozen HPA raw-IF CNN on an independent Allen Cell endogenous-tag imaging domain after the preregistered OpenCell primary holdout was refused before image download

prior_source.reason: literal frozen ontology yielded five rather than six sufficiently supported common classes

feature_index_contract.column_resolution: Unicode casefold and remove non-alphanumeric characters; resolve exact aliases for cell identifier, Allen cell-line identifier, and tagged structure; ambiguous or missing columns refuse

sampling_contract.selection: salted SHA-256 order within every fixed line; select at most 24 cells whose crop object resolves exactly
sampling_contract.wildtype_OOD: select up to 128 rows explicitly labelled wildtype, untagged, parental, or no structure by the same salted order

image_contract.channel_resolution: resolve nucleus by OME channel name containing DNA, Hoechst, nucleus, or 405 and target by channel name containing structure, GFP, EGFP, tagged, or 488; if either is absent or ambiguous refuse the image
image_contract.z_projection: maximum intensity projection per selected channel
image_contract.per_channel_scaling: finite p1/p99 clipping to [0,1] with all-zero output when p99 is not above p1
image_contract.geometry: center-crop to square then area-resize to 128x128

evaluation_contract.primary_unit: cell image with mandatory metrics by whole cell line
evaluation_contract.prediction_aggregation: no cell-level fitting; report cell-level metrics and arithmetic-mean logits per cell line
evaluation_contract.thresholds_temperature_and_conformal: use frozen HPA checkpoint values unchanged

authority_contract.reason_uncertainty_authority_false: most canonical structures have one gene-edited line, so many cell images cannot substitute for independent biological lines

failure_policy.endpoint_failure: retain as independent-provider diagnostic only and permanently consume selected cells
failure_policy.endpoint_success: promote raw-IF localization representation to independent-provider domain-shift validated, while retaining uncertainty and Aleph authority blocks
